categories.title: Go the Distance
categories.intro: From zero to HERO! [excited] It's all about Disney's Hercules. Get ready to go the distance.

clues.clue: Hercules' grumpy trainer Phil is a satyr: half man, half this animal.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is a goat! [laughs] Half man, half goat, ALL attitude.

clues.clue: Hercules falls for this sharp-tongued woman, who prefers to be called Meg.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Megara! [mischievously] She won't say she's in love. We all know she is.

clues.clue: In Hercules, the three Fates who see the future share just one of these.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is an eye! [chuckles] One eyeball, three sisters. Imagine the arguments.

clues.clue: Hercules becomes a celebrity hero in this ancient Greek city, the Big Olive.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Thebes! [laughs] The Big Olive. Phil calls it that, so it's official.

clues.clue: Hades plans to take over Mount Olympus when the planets align and he frees these giant elemental beings.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Titans! [dramatic pause] Lava, ice, wind and rock... and one big Cyclops tagging along.

categories.title: Maui Wowie
categories.intro: What can I say except... YOU'RE WELCOME! [laughs] This category is all about Moana's ocean myths.

clues.clue: Maui uses this magic weapon to shape-shift.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is his magic fishhook! [excited] No hook, no Maui. Simple as that.

clues.clue: Maui's favorite form is this bird of prey.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is a hawk! [chuckles] Giant hawk Maui. Very majestic. Very feathery.

clues.clue: Moana's name means this in several Polynesian languages, fitting for a girl the waves choose.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is ocean! [whispers] The ocean chose her. And she was literally named after it. Destiny.

clues.clue: Moana and Maui are attacked by these tiny pirates who wear coconut armor.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Kakamora! [laughs] Small, coconutty and SHOCKINGLY organized.

clues.clue: Glittery crab Tamatoa lives in Lalotai, also known as the Realm of these.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is monsters! [mischievously] Lalotai, the Realm of Monsters. Shiny, but very bad for your health.

categories.title: Legends in the Parks
categories.intro: Myths and legends hide all over the Disney parks. [mischievously] Some of them are even watching you.

clues.clue: Magic Kingdom's Adventureland lets you fly in a circle on The Magic Carpets of this film.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Aladdin! [laughs] Watch out for the camel. He spits. On PURPOSE.

clues.clue: Tokyo DisneySea's port themed to Captain Nemo's volcano hideaway is called this.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Mysterious Island! [excited] Nemo's secret base inside a rumbling volcano. Peak Imagineering.

clues.clue: Tokyo DisneySea's smoking volcano is named for this Greek Titan who stole fire from the gods.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Prometheus! [chuckles] Mount Prometheus even burps fire now and then. Hades would be jealous.

clues.clue: At Aulani, Disney's Hawaii resort, guests hunt for these legendary little people of Hawaiian folklore.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Menehune! [whispers] Legend says they build at night. Look closely, they're hiding everywhere.

clues.clue: Imagineers and fans call the abominable snowman inside Disneyland's Matterhorn Bobsleds by this human name.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Harold! [laughs] A very scary yeti with a VERY friendly name.

categories.title: Lost Empires
categories.intro: Lost cities, lost dragons, and maybe your lost points. [chuckles] It's Atlantis and Raya time!

clues.clue: In a 2001 Disney film, Milo's expedition searches for this legendary sunken city.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Atlantis! [excited] It's in the title, folks. Easy points!

clues.clue: Sisu, the last dragon in Raya and the Last Dragon, is voiced by this actress and rapper.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Awkwafina! [laughs] Kelly Marie Tran voices Raya, so close but no dragon.

clues.clue: In Raya and the Last Dragon, this swirling purple plague turns people to stone.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Druun! [sighs] Purple, sparkly, and absolutely NOT fun.

clues.clue: Milo Thatch needs this ancient book to find Atlantis.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Shepherd's Journal! [mischievously] Only Milo could read it. Good thing he's a nerd.

clues.clue: Atlantis's made-up language was created by this linguist, who also built the Klingon language.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Marc Okrand! [excited] Klingon AND Atlantean. That man's mouth deserves a museum.
